predicate.label: lobbyist for principal
predicate.definition: Person or organization X holds or held an explicitly identified lobbying role for principal Y.
includes: explicit lobbyist for or of Y
excludes: director of legislation or another managerial title without a lobbying role
ordinary advocacy, communication, legal service, or political agreement alone
membership in the principal organization alone
ambiguous: unclear lobbying principal or title attachment
predicate.notes: Legislative directorship and lobbying can coexist but are distinct roles. The definition does not infer lobbying from a legislative director title.
predicate.scope_notes: Includes: explicit lobbyist for or of Y; historical lobbying service for Y. Excludes: director of legislation or another managerial title without a lobbying role; ordinary advocacy, communication, legal service, or political agreement alone; membership in the principal organization alone. Ambiguous unless resolved by case-local evidence: unclear lobbying principal or title attachment; incomplete institution or personal principal. Legislative directorship and lobbying can coexist but are distinct roles. The definition does not infer lobbying from a legislative director title.

rationale: Explicit lobbyist paths total five and form the largest specific role family; director of legislation, ownership and other roles remain separate.
